welcome.text: Oh, you're awake. Good. Welcome to Kami's Lookout, {name}. I'm the Supreme Kai. I'm sorry, but we need your help right away.
Down in Hell there's a machine that cleans the evil out of souls. Someone broke it. Now all that evil is leaking into your world.
We call it the Malice. It takes over strong, proud fighters and brings out the worst in them. We call them the Corrupted.
Corrupted... So what do you need me for?
Goku went down to Hell to check on the machine, and he hasn't come back. So I started the Corrupt Patrol. Right now, that's you.
The Malice touched you on your way up here, and nothing happened. It couldn't take hold of you. I don't know why yet.
Press Circle to talk to someone nearby. Triangle opens the world map so you can fly somewhere, and START opens the Patrol Menu.
Go whenever you're ready, {name}. And... thank you.

brief.text: Here's our first report. There's been lightning over the Rocky Area all morning, and not a cloud in the sky.
It's Piccolo's ki. But it feels wrong. It feels like his father, King Piccolo.
Piccolo shares a soul with Kami. If the Malice can take over someone like him, it can take over anyone. Be careful, {name}.
Got it. Any advice before my first fight?
He can regrow lost limbs, so don't hold back. And don't let him get behind you.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Rocky Area. Piccolo's ki is coming from up ahead.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: So the Kais sent a rookie to stop me? They must be desperate.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Piccolo, that's not you talking. You can still fight it!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Fight it? Why? This is who I really am. The son of King Piccolo! I wasted years babysitting Goku's brat.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: My father wanted to rule this world. I'll finish what he started. Starting with you!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Gh... get out... GET OUT OF MY HEAD!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Violet smoke pours out of Piccolo and fades away.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Damn it... I said those things about Gohan. I remember all of it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That smell... Black Water Mist. Kami remembers it. But that's impossible. It was sealed away with its master.

win.speaker: player
win.text: Its master? Who?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Kami knows who it is. I can feel it. But he won't tell me. Take me to the Lookout. I'll make him talk.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Stay down, rookie. My father would have finished you. Be glad I'm not him... yet.

after.text: Kami fought that mist a long time ago. It turned people into wild beasts. He sealed away the one who brought it.
Looks like he didn't seal him well enough.
Then someone has brought it back. Rest, Piccolo. {name}, you should train with him. I think he'd like that, too.
Hmph. Next report's from the Wasteland. It's Vegeta. If the Malice got to him, we're in trouble.

brief.text: Vegeta has blasted his own name into the Wasteland. It's so big you can see it from space.
Typical Vegeta.
He's challenging every fighter he finds and making the losers bow to him. The ones who won't bow... don't get back up.
I'm coming with you. Vegeta's pride is dangerous on a good day. With the Malice, he'll try to break you just to prove he can.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Wasteland. Vegeta is waiting in the middle of a huge crater.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Piccolo. And some nobody. The Kais really are insulting me.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Listen to yourself, Vegeta. That thing is using your pride against you.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Using it? No! It finally understands me! Second to Kakarot, a prince with no planet... I put up with it for years!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: With this power, I'll rule again. A new empire of strong warriors, and no one will ever say the name Kakarot again!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: You're not ruling anything. I'm stopping you right here!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ha! You've got guts, nobody. I'll enjoy knocking them out of you!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No... I am... the PRINCE OF ALL SAIYANS!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The violet glow leaves Vegeta. He stays down on one knee.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It was in my head. Using my own voice. Telling me exactly what I wanted to hear.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No one uses the Prince of all Saiyans! Not Frieza, not Babidi, and not some filthy smoke! Whoever did this, I'll find them myself!

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Then come back to the Lookout and help us find them.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Hmph. Fine. For now. And you, nobody... you're stronger than you look. Don't let it go to your head.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Now bow! Bow before the Prince of all Saiyans!

after.text: I'll train your rookie, Kai. Not as a favor. When I find whoever did this, I want someone useful backing me up.
Um... thank you, Vegeta.
We've got a problem. Gohan went to the Cell Games Arena. Alone. He hasn't been back there since the day he beat Cell.

brief.text: Gohan's ki is huge, and it keeps rising. It feels just like it did on the day of the Cell Games.
He was just a kid. Goku sent him into that ring and told him to get angry. We all stood there and let it happen. So did I.
The Malice goes after old wounds. That one never healed.
I'm going with {name}. If he's got something to say to me, he can say it to my face.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Cell Games Arena. Gohan is standing alone in the ring.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Mr. Piccolo. You brought help this time. That's new. Last time, I was the help.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Gohan, come home. Videl's worried sick. So is your mother.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Everyone wants me home, until a monster shows up. Then it's "Gohan, get angry!" "Gohan, let it out!" Well, here it is!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: For once, I'm the one everyone's scared of. I don't have to be brave anymore. It feels good.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Gohan, this isn't you. You're hurting the people who care about you!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Don't tell me who I am! Let's see how brave YOU are when it's your turn in the ring!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Stop... please... I don't want to fight anymore...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The violet ki slowly drains out of Gohan.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Mr. Piccolo, I... I said those things to you. And about Dad. I don't even know if I meant them.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Some of it, maybe. And that's okay. You were a kid, and we put it all on you. I'm sorry, Gohan.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: There was more. The power Elder Kai unlocked in me. I almost used it on you. Part of me wanted to.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: I can't touch that power again. Not yet. I'm sorry, {name}. But I'll teach you everything else I know.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Please, just stay down. I don't want to hurt you any more.

after.text: I'm going to call home first. Then I want to train with {name}. I need to get my head straight.
Kibito Kai has been tracking the rifts the Malice comes through. One just opened over Namek, and someone is waiting under it.
Frieza. Great.

brief.text: Namek is falling apart again. Thank goodness the Namekians got away in time.
It's definitely Frieza's ki. But he isn't rampaging. He's just sitting there. Waiting for someone.
Waiting? For who?
Us, probably. I'll go. I was just a little kid on Namek when he killed Krillin. I want to face him now that I'm grown up.
Be careful. Frieza is cruel when he's calm, and worse when he's scared. Find out what the Malice is feeding on.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Planet Namek. The ground is cracking and the sky is dark.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: My, my. Visitors. And little Gohan, all grown up. How nice. You're just in time to watch me destroy this planet.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: That violet ki isn't yours, Frieza. Something's controlling you!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Controlling me? Don't be silly. A shabby little green wizard offered me this power, and I took it. I'm not the one being used.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Then why is your hand shaking?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Silence! This time I'll destroy Namek properly. No Saiyan monkeys getting in my way. Only me!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: What is this... get OFF me! How DARE you!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The Malice tears out of Frieza. He's shaking with rage.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It was in my thoughts. Going through them, like a servant digging through my things.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: That wretched wizard didn't give me anything. He LENT it to me! As if I were some pawn he could use and throw away!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Very well. I'll train your little pet, Kais. When we find that wizard, I'll need someone to hold him down for me.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: I think that's the nicest thing Frieza has ever said.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Ohohoho! Is that all? Stay right there. You'll have a lovely view when this planet explodes.

after.text: Your wizard was short and green, with pointed ears and an annoying little voice. He called himself the rightful guardian of something.
Kami knows who that is. I can feel him reacting.
At least now we know what he looks like. There's more: Cell has been spotted in the City Ruins. He's not attacking. He's studying something.

brief.text: Cell is burning huge circles into the streets of the City Ruins. Circles inside circles, all across the city.
It's a map. Each circle marks a rift where the Malice came into this world. He's found every one we know about, and three we didn't.
Of course he has. That insect can't leave anything alone.
I'm going. I let him become perfect once, just because I wanted a better fight. This time I'll finish him.
Bring back that map if you can. Cell might understand this Malice better than any of us.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The City Ruins at night. Cell stands in the middle of a glowing violet circle.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Vegeta. Still upset about letting me become perfect? And you brought the Kais' little rookie. The one the Malice won't touch.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You interest me, rookie. Everyone the Malice touches glows violet. But not you. It's like you have no past at all.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Enough talk, Cell. That thing is eating you alive.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Eating me? I'm made from the best of Goku, Frieza, Piccolo and you. The Malice is the worst of everyone. Now I'm truly complete!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: And every rift points to the same place: a star that isn't on any map. Something is coming. I intend to be there when it arrives.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Impossible! I'm... perfect...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The violet ki pulls away from Cell and disappears.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It left me. It just threw me away! How dare it? I'm perfect!

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Forget that. The map. Where does it point?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: See for yourself, Vegeta. The rifts all lead to a star heading for Earth. The old legends call it the Makyo Star.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Train the rookie? Gladly. I want to know why the Malice won't touch them. Think of it as research.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Is that all? How disappointing. I expected more from the Kais' champion.

after.text: The Makyo Star. Kami knows that name. When it gets close to Earth, demons from the Makyo get stronger. The one Kami sealed away was one of them.
Then we don't have much time. But first, Mr. Satan called me in tears. Buu hasn't eaten in two days, and all his candy has turned violet.

brief.text: Mister Kai! It's Buu! He's not himself! He says I only keep him around so I can take credit for beating Majin Buu!
I mean, that's not totally wrong, but still!
Mr. Satan, calm down. Where is he now?
At the World Tournament Stage! He's holding his own tournament, and the losers get turned into candy! I'm not going anywhere near it!
Buu has a good heart, but a terrible temper. {name}, try not to make him angrier. But hurry.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The World Tournament Stage. The stands are full of lollipops. Every one of them used to be a person.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Oh! New fighter! You here for Buu's tournament? Losers get turned into candy! Buu loves candy!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Buu, Mr. Satan is worried about you. He sent me to help.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Liar! Mr. Satan doesn't need Buu! Buu heard him on the phone! Buu heard EVERYTHING! Buu angry!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Violet steam pours from Buu's head. It takes shape as a thin, grey Buu.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Hee hee hee. The fat one is sad. Not me. I'm just HUNGRY.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Bad Buu, wait your turn! ...No. Fine. We fight together. Buu doesn't care anymore!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: No! Not back inside the fat one! NOOO!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Evil Buu fades away, and the Malice is pulled out of Buu.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Buu... Buu turned people into candy. Buu almost ate the mailman!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The lollipops turn back into people. They're dizzy, but they're okay.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Buu wants to say sorry to Mr. Satan. Then Buu will train {name}! Buu is a good teacher!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Hee hee! You lose! Now Buu turns you into candy!

lose.speaker: enemy2
lose.text: Don't eat it yet. I want to hear it scream first.

after.text: Buu said sorry! To me! So I said sorry back, and we had cake! Ha ha ha! The champ and his best friend, back together!
I'm glad. But Kibito Kai felt where the Malice went after it left Buu. It went to my world. Where Buu was first sealed away.
It knows where Buu came from. It's trying to wake up the very first Buu. The most dangerous one of all.

brief.text: I watched Kid Buu kill the other Supreme Kais. I was the only one left. He didn't even bother to finish me off.
When Kid Buu died, his soul went through the machine. The good in him was reborn as a boy named Uub. The evil was cleaned out and locked in the tank.
But the tank is broken. The Malice is pulling all that evil back together into Kid Buu. And it's doing it on my world.
I'm coming. I got stuck inside Super Buu once. I owe him for that.
I should be the one to go. But I froze in front of him once, and I'm afraid I'd freeze again. I'm sorry, {name}.
Don't worry, Supreme Kai. We'll handle it.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Supreme Kai's World. A violet storm is swirling in the sky.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Piccolo! I remember you. You were tasty! And who's this? I can't sense anything inside you at all.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: The fat one won't stop saying sorry, so I came out to play without him. And look who I found!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Behind Super Buu, a small pink figure is crouching in the grass.

intro.speaker: enemy2
intro.text: Hyaaaaaa! Hee hee hee hee!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Kid Buu... The one who killed the Supreme Kais. Don't let your guard down for a second, {name}.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Two Buus at once? Fine. Bring it on!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Isn't he cute? Come on, little guy. Let's blow this whole planet up!

win.speaker: enemy2
win.text: Gyaaah... ahh...

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No! The Malice is gone! Bah... Fine. I'm going back inside the fat one. He never even notices I'm in there.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Kid Buu stares at his hands as the violet fades. Then he sits down and starts eating the flowers.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: That's the monster that killed the Supreme Kais?

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Kid Buu looks up, copies your fighting stance, and grins.

win.speaker: player
win.text: ...I think he wants a rematch.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Don't worry. I'll absorb you too. You can keep Piccolo company in there!

after.text: You're back! Both of you! And Kid Buu is in my garden eating the flowers. Well, I suppose that's better than eating us.
There's something else. Down in Hell, the Malice made a sound. Almost like a word. It's as if it's learning to talk.
And we've found Goku's ki. He isn't in Hell. He's at home on Mount Paozu, and he's been hiding his ki there for weeks.
Weeks? Then why hasn't he told anyone?
I don't know. But I don't like it.

brief.text: Chichi says Goku came home weeks ago and made her promise to keep it secret. A surprise for us, he said. He sits on the roof every night, watching the sky.
Supreme Kai, look at the rift map. The very first rift opened over Mount Paozu. Before Piccolo. Before any of them.
...No. Goku went to Hell to stop this. He would never...
Never what? Pass up a chance to fight someone stronger? Hmph. I'm going. If Kakarot is behind this, the first punch is mine.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Mount Paozu. Goku is sitting on the roof of his house, smiling up at the violet sky.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Hey, Vegeta! Hey, {name}! Wow, you got really strong! I knew you would. I kept sending you tougher guys to fight!

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Sending...? So it was you, Kakarot. You opened the rifts. You let it take Piccolo. You let it take your own son!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Gohan was holding back! Everybody's always holding back! The little guy in Hell showed me. With the Malice, nobody ever holds back again!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Think about it, Vegeta! Everybody at full power, all the time! No more waiting years for someone strong enough to fight!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: And what happens when there's nobody left standing?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Then I guess it's just you and me! Come on, I've been waiting for this fight the most!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ha... ha ha... Aw, man. You really got me...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The violet light slowly drains out of Goku.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: I was gonna stop it. I really was. But that little green guy said, 'What if nobody ever had to hold back again?' And I... I wanted that.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: You wanted it so badly you handed it your own son. Pathetic, Kakarot.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Yeah... I know. I've gotta fix this, Vegeta. All of it.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: {name}, the guy's name is Garlic Jr. He said when the Makyo Star rises, he's taking the Lookout. That's your base, right?

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Ha ha! That was great! Come on, get up! I'll wait. Nobody has to hold back anymore!

after.text: Chichi hit me with a frying pan. Then she cried. Then she hit me again. I guess I deserved that one.
Dad... We'll talk later. Right now Garlic Jr. is coming. I remember him. I fought him when I was little.
Kami finally told me the name. Garlic's father wanted to be Guardian of Earth, but Kami was chosen. The son never forgave either of us.
Then we defend the Lookout. Everyone, get ready.

brief.text: You can see the Makyo Star in broad daylight now. And someone is climbing up the side of the Lookout. Slowly. He's in no hurry at all.
That's him. He climbed like that last time too. Like the place already belongs to him.
Let me go. After what I did, I owe everybody.
No, Goku. The Malice might still have a hold on you. Gohan, {name}, the Lookout is in your hands.
Last time I fought him, I was four. I cried until my power exploded. This time I'm going to do it right.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Kami's Lookout. A small figure climbs over the edge.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: At last. The Lookout. It belonged to my father, and that Namekian Kami stole it from him!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: And little Gohan. You sealed me in the Dead Zone, boy. Do you know how long I was trapped in there? I never forgot you.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: You broke the machine in Hell! You put that evil inside my dad!

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Your father begged for it! They all do. The Malice can take any heart with pride in it. Any heart... except yours.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: You! The Malice won't stick to you. No grudges, no regrets, no past at all. What ARE you?

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: The one who's going to beat you. That's all you need to know.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Kneel! KNEEL! I am the Guardian! I am IMMORTAL!

win.speaker: player2
win.text: I've been scared of my own power ever since the Malice touched it. But not anymore! Haaaaaa!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Gohan's white aura pushes the violet away. Garlic Jr. stumbles back toward the edge.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Malice! Come to me! I created you! Do you hear me?! I CREATED YOU!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Something deep in Hell answers, but not him. The Makyo Star flares red, and Garlic Jr. vanishes into its light.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: He's gone to the Makyo Star. He's going to take its power for himself!

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Off the edge you go! It's a long way down, and I want to hear you scream the whole way.

after.text: That power didn't come from the Malice. It was mine. {name}, I think I'm ready to help you find yours now.
Garlic Jr. is on the Makyo Star, soaking up its power. When he comes back, he'll be stronger than anyone on Earth.
Then I'm going with {name}. I started all this. The least I can do is help finish it.
Supreme Kai, I heard the Malice in Hell again. This time it was clear. It's saying its own name.

brief.text: The Makyo Star is close enough to see its craters now. Garlic Jr. is on the surface, and his power keeps growing.
If he comes back to Earth with that power, his Black Water Mist will cover the whole planet within an hour. Everyone would be Corrupted.
Then we go to him! {name}, grab my shoulder. Instant Transmission's a lot faster than flying.
Goku. Bring {name} back safe.
I will. This time I won't let anybody down.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Outer Space. The Makyo Star looms huge and red. Garlic Jr. stands on its surface, much bigger than before.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Goku. The one who wanted it most. Have you come crawling back for more?

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: Nope. I came to tell you no thanks. Took me a while to figure that out, though.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Look at me! The Makyo Star is MINE! The Malice is MINE! When I return to the Lookout, the living and the dead will kneel before me!

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Then why is the Malice pulling away from you?

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: It's not! It obeys me! It has ALWAYS obeyed me!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: My star... my power... Why won't you ANSWER me?!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The violet leaves Garlic Jr. all at once. He shrinks back to his normal size, gasping for breath.

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: It's gone... It didn't come back to me. It went back to the machine. It was never mine. It was just waiting until it got strong enough.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Strong enough for what? What's down there, Garlic?

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Something with no master! It ate my Mist and all my plans! Fools! You beat the only one who wanted to RULE it! Now it just wants to destroy everything!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Far away in Hell, a huge round shape opens its eyes and claps its hands twice.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Kneel, Saiyan. You first, then the empty one. I've waited centuries for this, and I'm going to enjoy it.

after.text: Garlic Jr. is locked under a Kai seal in Hell, where he belongs. He keeps offering to help us. I keep ignoring him.
You'll need me. I know that machine better than the ogres who run it. Learn my Dead Zone, and use it on that monster.
Hell is changing. The Soul Cleansing Machine has swallowed the ogres around it. Something huge is sitting on top of it, humming.
Janemba. That's the name it's been saying. {name}, I'm sorry. You have to go to Hell.
Hell, huh? ...Okay. I'm ready.

brief.text: Hell is falling apart. The trees are growing upside down and the Blood Pool is flowing uphill. Paikuhan is holding the gate, but he can't last long.
I'm coming. Not to save Hell. It's a dreadful place. But that blob has taken over MY corner of it, and I want it back.
Janemba is the Malice with a body, Frieza. All the evil ever cleaned out of souls. Some of it came from you.
Then it has excellent taste. Come along, {name}. Do try to keep up.
It's still growing. Stop it before it figures out what it can do.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Hell. The sky is upside down. A huge round creature sits on the broken machine, swinging its legs and humming.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Ja... nem... BA!

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: It claps twice, and the ground behind you twists into a giant mouth. Then it's just ground again.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Kneel. Stay down. Everyone at full power. Losers become candy.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Every phrase comes out in a different voice. You've heard all of them before.

intro.speaker: player2
intro.text: My, my. It's repeating every Corrupted fighter you've beaten, {name}. Do try not to become part of its collection.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: JA-NEM-BA!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: Ja... nem...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Janemba's body splits down the middle. It isn't dying. Something is climbing out of it.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: Oh, you must be joking.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: A tall, thin demon steps out of the empty shell, holding a huge sword.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: It slices a hole in the air. Through it, you can see the Lookout. The demon steps through, and the hole stays open.

win.speaker: player2
win.text: {name}, I suggest we retreat. I have never said that in my life. Forget you ever heard it.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: Ja-nem-BA! Stay down! Stay down! Stay down!

after.text: Super Janemba cut a hole between Hell and Earth, and it gets wider every hour. If it opens all the way, the living world and the dead are both finished.
Anyone who gets close to it falls to their knees. Vegeta. Goku. Me. It makes you relive your worst day until you give up.
But it showed {name} nothing. Its sword went right through. There was nothing inside for it to cut.
I think I finally understand why. Come see me when you're ready, {name}. There's something I should have told you from the start.

brief.text: The day the machine broke, its last cycle ran too long. One soul was cleaned so completely that nothing was left. It was sent into the world brand new.
I felt you arrive, {name}. I didn't know what you were. I only knew the Malice couldn't get a grip on you. I'm sorry I never told you.
So Janemba is all the evil they cleaned out of people... and I'm what's left when the cleaning works?
Janemba is every bad memory that was ever thrown away. You're the only one with no past at all. It can't get inside you.
We'll lure it into the Hyperbolic Time Chamber and shut the door. There's no way out of there. Only you can go in. I'll be waiting right here.
Got it. Let's end this.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: The Hyperbolic Time Chamber. A red sky and black trees start spreading across the endless white.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: We were the Demon King's ambition. We were Frieza's first kill. We were the hunger of the little pink one who killed the Kais.

intro.speaker: narrator
intro.text: Super Janemba speaks in a thousand voices at once. Every one of them belongs to someone with regrets.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Show us your worst day, empty one.

intro.speaker: player
intro.text: Sorry. I don't have one. I'm new here.

intro.speaker: enemy
intro.text: Then we will give you one. And it will last forever!

win.speaker: enemy
win.text: No... past... nothing... to hold on to...

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Super Janemba breaks apart into a thousand voices, and one by one they go silent. The red fades away.

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: Far below, in Hell, the Soul Cleansing Machine rattles and starts working again.

win.speaker: player
win.text: ...Hello? Supreme Kai? You said you'd be right here!

win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The Chamber door opens. The Supreme Kai and Kibito Kai are standing there. The Supreme Kai has clearly been crying.

lose.speaker: enemy
lose.text: There. Now you have a worst day. We will keep it for you. Forever.

after.text: You did it, {name}! The machine is running, Hell is back to normal, and Frieza is complaining about the hot springs again.
Now that the boundary is safe, we have some time. If you'll have us, the Supreme Kai and I would like to train you too.
It's the least we can do. Besides, I've always wanted a student who doesn't fall asleep when I talk about history.

ending.text: The machine is working again. Mostly. There's a stain at the bottom of the tank that won't come out. Kibito Kai says it never will.
So there might be more Corrupted someday? Huh. That's bad. But if there are... you'll call me, right?
Kakarot is on probation. Call me first. Never call him.
And not every rift has closed. Small ones, old ones. Fighters pulled out of their own time are still wandering around, still angry.
So the Patrol stays open. The quest board, the masters, the map. All of it.
As for who you were before... the machine keeps no records. Maybe we'll find out together someday. Or maybe it doesn't matter.
Every day from now on is yours, {name}. Not many of us can say that. Go on. The world needs you, and Krillin's board is filling up.

lookout.desc: Kami's palace above the clouds and the Patrol's base. Videl's wardrobe is here, and so is the door to the Time Chamber.

timechamber.desc: A huge white room where a whole year passes in one day. The air is thin and the gravity is heavy.
timechamber.arrive: The Hyperbolic Time Chamber. The door shuts behind you.

kamehouse.desc: Master Roshi's little island home. Krillin keeps the bounty board here.

tournament.desc: The World Tournament ring. Mr. Satan runs his shop here, and Uub trains by the stands.
tournament.arrive: The World Tournament Stage. Mr. Satan's face is on every banner.

paozu.desc: Forests and rivers around the Son family's house. Chichi lives here, and Goku is never far away.
paozu.arrive: Mount Paozu. The Son family's home.

wasteland.desc: Red rock and craters as far as you can see. This is where the Saiyans landed. Yamcha keeps watch nearby.
wasteland.arrive: The Wasteland. This is where the Saiyans fought Goku's friends.

rocky.desc: Cliffs and canyons covered in old battle scars. Tien trains out here.
rocky.arrive: The Rocky Area. Someone is training up ahead.

mountain.desc: A winding road through the mountains. Namu once walked it to bring water home to his village.
mountain.arrive: Mountain Road. There are fresh flowers at the shrine. Namu was here.

islands.desc: Green islands in a blue sea. Android 18 lives nearby, and she doesn't like surprises.
islands.arrive: The Islands. Someone is watching you.

city.desc: Broken streets and empty buildings, wrecked by the Androids and Cell. Trunks patrols what's left.
city.arrive: City Ruins. Nobody lives here anymore.

desert.desc: Sand, heat and bandits. Yajirobe is out here somewhere, supposedly standing guard.
desert.arrive: The Desert. The heat is unbearable.

glacier.desc: A frozen field in the far north. Android 16 comes here to watch the birds.
glacier.arrive: The Glacier. It's freezing up here.

penguin.desc: Arale's home town. Strange things happen here every day, and nobody minds.

muscle.desc: The Red Ribbon Army's old fortress in the snow. The gentle giant Hatchan lives here now.
muscle.arrive: Muscle Tower. Hatchan keeps the doors open these days.

castle.desc: The King's Castle and the city around it. The Great Saiyaman patrols the rooftops.
castle.arrive: King's Castle. The King of Earth lives here.

cellarena.desc: The ring Cell built for the Cell Games is still standing. Pan trains here.
cellarena.arrive: The Cell Games Arena. The ring is still cracked from the final battle.

namek.desc: Green skies, blue grass and three suns. The Namekians' home planet. Nail keeps watch here.
namek.arrive: Planet Namek. The air smells strange.

space.desc: The empty space between planets. Bardock is out here, with nowhere else to go.

kaiworld.desc: The Sacred World of the Kai. Quiet fields and one giant tree. The Supreme Kai's home.
kaiworld.arrive: The Sacred World of the Kai. It's very quiet here.

hell.desc: Red skies, needle mountains and the Soul Cleansing Machine. Paikuhan keeps order here.
hell.arrive: Hell. You can feel evil all around you.

shop.text: Welcome, welcome! Everything here is approved by the World Champion. That's me! Ha ha ha!
This here is a Mr. Satan Power Drink! One sip and you'll be strong enough to beat Cell. Just like I did! Ha ha ha!
Patrol members get a discount! My buddy Buu told me to give you one. And I always listen to Buu!

board.text: The bounty board's up to date. Corrupted fighters, lost echoes, all kinds of trouble. Take your pick.
I'd take a few myself, but somebody has to keep track of all this. Guess that's me.
Be careful with the ones marked red. Those are the really dangerous ones. Trust me, I know.

wardrobe.text: Finish a master's lessons and I can make you an outfit in their style. Just come see me.
Gi, armor, a Saiyaman helmet... Please don't pick the helmet. I've seen enough of that thing.
Looking good! You fight better when you like what you're wearing.

trainer.text: The Training Grounds are open. Every master you've freed will teach you there, or at their home. Five lessons each.
The Hyperbolic Time Chamber is for serious training. A whole year passes in there for every day out here.
Each lesson teaches you one technique. Finish all five, and you can wear that master's style too.

story_idle.text: Rest if you need to. The Malice is still spreading, but at least it can't take you.
I've been reading Kami's old records. Some pages have been torn out. I wonder what he didn't want anyone to see.
Come talk to me when you're ready for the next lead. And {name}... thank you for coming back.

3.greet: Hey, {name}! You wanna train? Great! I'll teach you Instant Transmission. You find someone's ki and just go there. It took me a year to learn!
3.done: That's everything I've got in this form! You learn fast. Next time we spar, I won't hold back!

4.greet: I first went Super Saiyan on Namek, when Frieza killed Krillin. I'll teach you the moves. I hope you never feel that kind of anger.
4.done: You've got all of it! Krillin would be proud. I'm proud too! Hey, let's go get something to eat.

5.greet: Super Saiyan 2 is a big step up. Gohan got there first, at the Cell Games. I had to train really hard in Other World to catch up!
5.done: There! You've learned it all. Gohan was only eleven when he got this strong. Pretty amazing, huh?

6.greet: This form burns through energy really fast. So we go fast, we hit hard, and we stop before we run out. Ready?
6.done: Five for five! And you didn't even need the long hair. Wow, you're really something!

22.greet: This is how I fought when I wanted to conquer the world. Learn the techniques. Not the attitude.
22.done: That's all. You can fight like a demon now. Make sure you only do it when you have to.

23.greet: Training with me is quiet, slow and painful. Gohan survived it when he was four. You'll manage.
23.done: That's everything I teach. You did well. Hmph. Don't expect me to say that again.

31.greet: You want to learn from the Prince of all Saiyans? Fine. But I won't go easy on you. Not once.
31.done: You've learned my techniques. That doesn't mean you have my respect. ...Hmph. Maybe a little.

32.greet: I became a Super Saiyan alone, in deep space, by pushing myself past my limits. Now it's your turn. Don't disappoint me.
32.done: Not bad. Actually... that was good. If you tell Kakarot I said that, I'll deny it.

33.greet: With this form, I crushed an Android in seconds. Then my pride let Cell become perfect. Learn from both.
33.done: Done. You've learned everything Super Vegeta has to teach. Don't let it go to your head.

17.greet: I come here to train now. I used to be scared of this place. I want to make some better memories here.
17.done: That's everything. I feel calmer here than I have in years. Thank you, {name}. I mean it.

18.greet: When I go Super Saiyan, I stay calm. That's where the real strength comes from. Let's start there.
18.done: Great work! Oh, and if you see the Great Saiyaman around here... that's not me. Totally different guy.

19.greet: This is the form I beat Cell with. It also made me reckless. I'll teach you the power, not my mistakes.
19.done: You've got it, and you stayed in control the whole time. That's more than I did against Cell.

21.greet: The Old Kai spent hours unlocking my power. Don't worry, I won't make you sit through all that. Let's begin.
21.done: That's everything. I'm not afraid of this power anymore, and I don't want you to be either. Use it well.

94.greet: My, my. You want me to teach you? How amusing. Very well. Try to keep up, and try not to die.
94.done: There. You fight almost like a proper warrior now. Do try not to embarrass me in front of those monkeys.

95.greet: This is one hundred percent of my power. I'll show you what it can really do. Don't blink.
95.done: You've seen my full power and you're still alive. You should feel very lucky.

107.greet: I built this arena for the greatest tournament in history. Now I'm using it to teach you. Shall we begin?
107.done: Remarkable. You learn so quickly. I'd like to know why. Come back again, I want to study you.

108.greet: I came back from being blown to pieces even stronger than before. That's the power of Saiyan cells. Watch closely.
108.done: Flawless. Almost. Of course, only I can be truly perfect.

112.greet: Buu will teach you! But first, snacks! Then we play fight! Buu loves play fighting!
112.done: You learned everything! Buu is so happy! Here, you can have some of Buu's chocolate!

113.greet: The fat one only lets me out to teach. Fine. I'll teach you how to hurt people. Pay attention.
113.done: That's all. Now I go back inside the fat one. Don't forget me.

114.greet: I'm only here because the fat one wants me to be. Learn fast. If I get bored, I might absorb you.
114.done: Hmph. Not bad. You'd make a nice addition to me. That's a compliment.

117.greet: Hee hee hee! (Kid Buu jumps around you, screeching, then drops into a fighting stance. He wants you to copy him.)
117.done: Hee hee! (Kid Buu laughs and slaps you on the back. It looks like you passed. He goes back to playing.)

118.greet: Locked away by the Kais, and now I have to teach a Patrol brat? Fine. Learn my power, and remember who gave it to you.
118.done: There. You know all my techniques. I have all of eternity to get my revenge. Come visit. I'll be waiting.

119.greet: Without the Makyo Star, this form is only a shadow of itself. But it's still more than enough for you. Watch.
119.done: Enough. You can open the Dead Zone now. Just don't fall into it yourself. Believe me, I know.

137.greet: Ja... nem... BA! (Janemba claps its hands. A rock nearby turns into candy, then back into a rock. It wants to play.)
137.done: Ja... nem... ba... (Janemba pats your head and sits down, humming. Paikuhan says that means you're friends.)

138.greet: (Many voices speak at once from the machine's tank.) We have no past either. Come. We'll show you how everyone fights.
138.done: (The voices are quieter now.) You've learned everything we had. Use it for something good. We never could.

58.greet: I'm a bit out of practice. Kais aren't really meant to fight. But I've watched you train, and I know what you need.
58.done: That's all of it. A mortal using a Supreme Kai's techniques... My ancestors would be shocked. But I'm proud of you.

59.greet: Five lessons. I'll keep them short and precise. The Supreme Kai in me wants to wish you luck, so... good luck.
59.done: Complete. Both halves of me are very pleased with you. Well done, {name}.
